workItem.objective: Close the integration trust boundary by publishing a complete immutable digest manifest for the already verified cumulative attempt-004 and attempt-005 worker state.
deliverables: One sorted immutable integration manifest covering every difference between worker and parent in the cumulative attempt-004 authority scope, plus the exact attempt-005 raw handoff
Each manifest operation declares repository-relative path, create or replace mode, exact worker SHA-256, and exact expected parent SHA-256 or explicit absence
One raw attempt-006 BootstrapWorkItemHandoff binding the manifest raw digest and operation count while reusing the unchanged attempt-005 verification evidence
verificationPlan: Validate the exact attempt-005 task, raw handoff, and parent-review digests before manifest construction.
Enumerate files only from the cumulative attempt-004 authority directories and exact test paths; add the attempt-005 raw handoff explicitly.
For every worker file whose raw SHA-256 differs from the parent file or whose parent file is absent, emit exactly one sorted operation with its worker digest and pinned parent pre-state.

Require exactly 180 operations unless independent re-enumeration proves the parent state changed; any changed count or digest is baseline drift and must fail closed rather than being accepted silently.
Verify all relative paths are unique, non-rooted, slash-normalized, and contain no empty, dot, or traversal segment.

Do not rerun or restate new implementation verification: bind the exact unchanged 13/13 and two 696/696 attempt-005 evidence as inherited proof.
Parent will independently rebuild the same operation set before integration; the worker manifest is a proposal, not integration authority.
